turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment metric, so I cannot give that figure; the closest metrics are the cart-to-checkout rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on that day or the day after), cart sessions and checkout sessions. For 20 September to 3 October 2026 the cart-to-checkout rate was 40 % (5 cart sessions, 2 checkout sessions). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
